title.en: The owner's long view

what: Years of wear, renovation, a yearly reserve, selling with a tenant inside, the sale day, ending the business and handing the home on.

title.en: Wear of the home over the years

what: A habit of looking at the home once a year and writing down what ages, so a renovation is planned rather than forced.

title.en: Set a yearly visit to the home

what: Visit once a year with reasonable notice to the tenant, see the home and write down the state of each system.
when: every year, at a time agreed with the tenant
proof: a dated visit note with photos

law.quote: ובלבד שהמשכיר יודיע לו על כך זמן סביר מראש

if_skipped: Wear is found only when it becomes a breakdown.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.he: צלמו את אותם מקומות כל שנה
title.en: Photograph the same spots every year

what: Take photos of the same walls, floors, ceilings, bathroom and kitchen each year, so the change over time is visible.
proof: the yearly photo set with the date
if_skipped: No way to see slow wear.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): photos can be attached to a repair; no yearly photo set

title.he: סווגו כל פגם: של השוכר או שלכם
title.en: Classify each defect: the tenant's or yours

what: For every defect decide whether it came from unreasonable use (the tenant repairs at his cost, unless agreed otherwise) or not (you repair, unless minor).
proof: the classification noted on the repair record
money: The tenant pays for a defect caused by unreasonable use; the landlord pays for the other defects that are not minor.

law.quote: השוכר אחראי על כל ליקוי בדירה המושכרת, לרבות פגם, שנגרם עקב שימוש בלתי סביר
המשכיר יתקן על חשבונו כל ליקוי או פגם אחר

if_skipped: Arguments on who pays and a refund claim on exit.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): repairs recorded with urgency and fix-by days (rm-drawers.js, store.php); no wear history view

title.he: רשמו גיל של כל מערכת ומכשיר
title.en: Record the age of every system and appliance

what: Write the year each system and appliance was installed. Ask a professional how long that type usually lasts; the product does not invent a figure.
proof: a table of items and years
if_skipped: A planned replacement becomes an emergency.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): appliances recorded by name; no install-year field verified

title.en: Keep the repair history

what: Keep every repair, who did it and what it cost, in one list in the home's file.
proof: invoices linked to the list
if_skipped: No view of what the home really costs.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): repairs recorded with urgency and fix-by days (rm-drawers.js, store.php); no wear history view

title.en: Set a repainting cycle

what: Choose how often you repaint (a professional's advice); write the date of the last paint and the next planned one.
proof: the date of the last paint and the planned date

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.en: A renovation plan and when

what: List the work, do it between tenants, and keep records.

title.en: Write a renovation list by urgency

what: From the yearly visits list what must be done now, soon and later.
proof: the list with the priority of each line
if_skipped: Work is decided in a rush.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.en: Plan work between tenants

what: Schedule the larger work for the gap between two tenancies, since a tenant is entitled to use the home without disturbance from the landlord during the lease.
when: when a notice of exit arrives
proof: the schedule with the dates

law.quote: ללא הפרעה מצדו או מטעמו

if_skipped: Work during a lease may breach the tenant's right to use the home undisturbed.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.en: Ask for three quotes

what: Ask for at least three written quotes for each large item.
proof: three quotes saved
money: The quotes are the contractors' own figures; the product supplies none.
if_skipped: You pay more than needed.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): documents table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a file; no dedicated screen for this step

title.he: ענו בכתב כששוכר מבקש לשנות בדירה
title.en: Answer in writing when a tenant asks to change the home

what: A tenant may not change the home without the landlord's consent. Answer yes or no in writing, with conditions. Changes with consent may be restored or left at the tenant's choice, without payment.
proof: the written answer

law.quote: השוכר אינו רשאי לבצע שינויים במושכר, אלא אם כן קיבל את הסכמת המשכיר לשינויים
אין הוא זכאי לתמורה בשל השינויים שביצע

if_skipped: Changes without consent: the landlord may demand that the home be restored.

title.en: Keep the renovation invoices

what: Keep every invoice and give copies to the accountant; how a renovation is treated in tax is the accountant's answer (branch 07).
proof: scanned invoices
if_skipped: Costs cannot be shown later.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): ledger records an expense and CSV for the accountant; no invoice upload

title.he: עדכנו תמונות ורשימת מכשירים אחרי שיפוץ
title.en: Update photos and the appliance list after a renovation

what: Re-photograph the home and update the appliance list and the warranty dates.
proof: the new photo set and the list
if_skipped: The next handover has an old baseline.

title.he: עדכנו את המבטח אחרי שיפוץ גדול
title.en: Tell the insurer after a major renovation

what: Tell the insurer in writing about a major renovation and ask whether the cover changes.
proof: the insurer's written reply
if_skipped: The cover may not match the home. Terms differ by policy.

title.en: The yearly wear reserve

what: A habit: set money aside for the home each year. The owner chooses the rule; the product invents no percentage.

title.en: Choose a rule for setting money aside

what: Decide how you set money aside (a fixed sum per month, or a part of the rent) and write the rule.
proof: the rule written in the file
money: The sum is the owner's choice; the product supplies none.
if_skipped: Money is missing when a big repair comes.

title.he: פתחו הפרשה נפרדת בחשבון או בקופה
title.en: Keep the reserve in a separate place

what: Keep the reserve separate from your spending money so it is not used by mistake.
proof: a note of where the reserve sits

title.en: Set a monthly reminder to set money aside

what: Set a reminder after the rent arrives.
proof: the reminder
if_skipped: The habit lapses.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.he: רשמו כל הוצאה על הדירה בקטגוריה
title.en: Record each spend on the home by category

what: Mark each repair and replacement by category (plumbing, electric, appliance, paint).
proof: the ledger line
if_skipped: No view of where the money goes.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): ledger kind 'expense' with categories; repair categories in tickets

title.he: בדקו פעם בשנה אם ההפרשה מספיקה
title.en: Once a year check if the reserve is enough

what: Compare the year's spend with the reserve; change the rule if you went over or under.
when: every year, after the yearly visit
proof: a yearly note with the two figures

title.en: Selling with a tenant inside

what: What the lease does to a buyer and what the seller does for the tenant. Read: חוק השכירות והשאילה, ss. 21 and 25יא, and חוק המקרקעין s. 79. Not legal advice; a lawyer goes over the sale.

title.he: קראו את החוזה שנשאר: תקופה ואופציה
title.en: Read the lease that stays: term and option

what: Open the lease, note the end date, the option to extend and who holds it, and any right to cancel; the buyer will meet all of these.
proof: a summary of the lease terms

law.quote: כוחה של הזכות יפה כלפי כל אדם

if_skipped: The buyer finds terms you did not mention.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): lease builder keeps the signed text and an evidence file per lease (/rm/evidence)

title.en: Check if the lease is registered

what: A lease of up to five years does not need registration; one with an option that takes it over five years, or a lease that starts later, does. Check with the land registry what is registered on the home.
when: before listing the home for sale
proof: the registry extract

law.quote: שכירות לתקופה שאינה עולה על חמש שנים אינה טעונה רישום

if_skipped: A buyer is surprised by a registered right.

title.he: אל תניחו שאפשר לסיים חוזה לפני המכירה
title.en: Do not assume the lease can be ended for the sale

what: A clause that lets the landlord cancel without a breach is void unless the tenant has a similar right; with it the landlord must give at least 90 days' notice. Sale is not named as a cause.
proof: the clause check noted

law.quote: תניה בחוזה שכירות למגורים המאפשרת למשכיר לבטל את החוזה שלא בשל הפרתו בטלה
90 ימים מראש, לפחות

if_skipped: An attempt to cancel is void; the lease stays.

title.en: Prepare the tenancy file for the buyer

what: Give the buyer a copy of the lease, the payment record, the security held and the list of open repairs.
proof: a list of what was handed with the date
if_skipped: The buyer cannot price the home with the tenant.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): evidence file per lease (/rm/evidence)

title.en: Close open repairs before the sale

what: A claim the tenant has against the landlord for obligations not kept before the transfer also stands against the buyer. Fix what you can before signing.
proof: the repair records closed

law.quote: תעמוד לו גם כלפי הרוכש

if_skipped: The buyer inherits the claim and may ask you for compensation.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): repairs recorded with urgency and fix-by days (rm-drawers.js, store.php); no wear history view

title.en: Tell the tenant in writing about the sale

what: Notify the tenant in writing, before the date he must hand the home to the buyer, with the buyer's details and how to reach him.
when: before the date of handing the home to the buyer
proof: the notice with the date and delivery proof

law.quote: יודיע על כך לשוכר בכתב, לפני המועד שבו עליו למסור את הדירה לרוכש הזכויות

if_skipped: A breach of the duty to notify; the tenant does not know whom to pay.

title.en: Pass the security to the buyer

what: The buyer steps into the landlord's rights and duties under the lease, which includes returning the security at the end. Agree in the sale contract how the security reaches him.
proof: the sale contract line and the transfer record

law.quote: יבוא הרוכש במקומו של המשכיר לעניין הזכויות והחיובים של המשכיר

if_skipped: Both of you may be asked to return the security.

title.en: Agree buyer visits with the tenant

what: Agree days and hours in writing with the tenant for potential buyers. The text I read covers inspection and repairs by the landlord; it does not name buyer visits, so the written agreement is what protects the tenant's undisturbed use.
proof: the tenant's written reply

law.quote: ללא הפרעה מצדו או מטעמו

if_skipped: A complaint on disturbance.

title.he: בררו אצל רואה חשבון מה המס על המכירה
title.en: Ask the accountant about the tax on the sale

what: Ask in writing what tax the sale of a rented home may bring and what must be reported. I did not read the Tax Authority's text on this, so no rate or deadline is claimed.
proof: the accountant's written reply
money: Tax is the seller's; the amount is the accountant's computation.
if_skipped: A surprise tax bill.

title.en: Sale-day tasks for a rented home

what: What is done on the day the home changes owner, with the tenant inside.

title.en: Read the meters with the tenant

what: Read the water, electricity and gas meters with the tenant and photograph them; the tenant pays the consumption for his period.
proof: photos of the meters with the date

law.quote: תשלומים בעד צריכה של שירותים שוטפים הניתנים לשוכר בדירה למגורים

if_skipped: A dispute on the consumption around the sale date.

title.he: בקשו מהשוכר אישור על מצב התשלומים
title.en: Ask the tenant to confirm the payments status

what: Ask the tenant in writing to confirm the rent paid up to the sale date, the security held and any open repair.
proof: the tenant's written reply
if_skipped: A later argument on what was paid.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): ledger records payments; no tenant confirmation step

title.he: ספרו לרוכש כל הסכם בעל פה
title.en: Tell the buyer every oral arrangement

what: Write down every promise or arrangement with the tenant that is not in the lease (a repair promised, a rent reduction) and give it to the buyer.
proof: the list given to the buyer

law.quote: תעמוד לו גם כלפי הרוכש

if_skipped: A claim against the buyer, and then against you.

title.he: מסרו לשוכר את פרטי הרוכש ואת דרך התשלום
title.en: Give the tenant the buyer's details and the way to pay

what: Tell the tenant to whom the rent goes from the sale date and how to reach the buyer.
proof: the message with the date

law.quote: בהודעה יפרט המשכיר את פרטי הרוכש ואת דרכי ההתקשרות עמו

if_skipped: The tenant keeps paying you.

title.he: בטלו או העבירו את ביטוח המבנה
title.en: Cancel or transfer the building insurance

what: Ask the insurer in writing what happens to the building policy on the sale date.
proof: the insurer's written reply
if_skipped: Premiums continue; or the buyer is left uninsured. Terms differ by policy.

title.he: בררו עם עורך הדין על הודעה לרשויות
title.en: Ask the lawyer about notices to the authorities

what: Ask the sale lawyer what to report to the municipality, the water and the electricity companies and the house committee about the change of owner. No deadline is claimed here.
proof: the lawyer's list
if_skipped: Bills keep coming to your name.

title.en: Hand over the spare keys and the documents

what: Hand the buyer your spare keys, the appliance warranties and the home's instruction sheet; the tenant keeps his keys.
proof: a signed list of what was handed
if_skipped: A missing warranty or key later.

title.en: Ending the rental business

what: Closing the file when the last home is sold or no longer rented.

title.en: Return every security within the time

what: Return the security, or what is left after lawful use, within 60 days of the home being returned to you, or by the date the tenant's debts were paid, whichever is later.
when: within 60 days of the return of the home
proof: the transfer record and a receipt from the tenant
money: The landlord returns it with its fruits; deductions only in the cases the law lists.

law.quote: בתוך 60 ימים ממועד השבת הדירה המושכרת לרשותו

if_skipped: The tenant can demand it and its fruits.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): securities recorded per lease; no automatic reminder

title.en: Make sure the home was returned empty

what: On the last day check the home is empty of people and things, except what belongs to the landlord.
proof: a signed return note with photos

law.quote: כשהוא פנוי מכל אדם או נכס

if_skipped: Items stay in the home and a dispute follows.

title.he: הכינו עם רואה חשבון את הדוח האחרון
title.en: Prepare the last report with the accountant

what: Send the accountant the full year's rent and expense records so he can report the end of the rental income. The tax rules and deadlines are his to state; I did not read the Tax Authority text here.
when: at the end of the last tax year of rental
proof: the accountant's confirmation
if_skipped: An open tax file; the consequence depends on the tax track.

what: Gather the contracts, receipts, protocols and photos in one folder, with a note of where it is. Ask the accountant how long to keep tax papers; none is claimed here.

if_skipped: A document is missing when a claim comes.

what: Delete tenants' personal details that you no longer need for a legal or tax purpose; keep the rest secure.

title.he: בטלו הוראות קבע ושירותים על שמכם
title.en: Cancel standing orders and services in your name

what: Cancel standing orders and any service you held for the home (house committee, water, gas, internet) once the tenancy ends.
proof: a confirmation per service
if_skipped: Payments continue for a home you no longer rent.

title.en: Handing the home to heirs

what: At a high level only. This is not legal advice; a lawyer is needed for a will or an inheritance order.

title.en: Prepare a "what there is and where" file for the heirs

what: Make a sheet with each home, its tenant, the lease end date, the security held, the insurance policies and where the papers are.
proof: the sheet with the date
if_skipped: Heirs and tenants do not know what exists.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): evidence file per lease; no heirs sheet

title.en: Tell a close person where the file is

what: Tell a family member or a lawyer where the file is and how to reach it.
proof: the person's written reply

title.en: Understand the lease continues

what: The estate passes to the heirs at death, and the tenant's right to use the home holds against anyone, so the lease continues with the heirs in the landlord's place. Confirm with a lawyer for your case.
proof: a note in the heirs file

law.quote: במות אדם עובר עזבונו ליורשיו
כוחה של הזכות יפה כלפי כל אדם

title.he: שוחחו עם עורך דין על צוואה
title.en: Talk with a lawyer about a will

what: Ask a lawyer how you want the homes to pass, by will or by law. The registrar for inheritance declares the heirs' rights by an inheritance order, or by a probate order when there is a will.
proof: the lawyer's note

law.quote: הרשם לעניני ירושה רשאי להצהיר על זכויות היורשים
